en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?
I want to scream really loud!
Let's make a tower of books
No, no... I don't need to study.

Cuz if I ever need to know something,
I just gotta ask Atua.

You still got a lot to learn about me,
Shuichi.

If you're loud for no reason, you will
incur Atua's wrath.
Are you trying to displease Atua?

If you do that, you won't live to see
tomorrow.

Do you wanna meet Atua by building a
tower of books that reaches the sky?

It's a good idea, but there aren't enough
books here.

If you want, I can deliver a message to
Atua for you.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Angie looks deep in thought...
